grants.description: Verify your identity using your National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and access your National Insurance record for crediting

grants.description: Access your National Insurance record to assess gaps and apply credits
grants.purpose: To determine which tax years need Carer's Credit and to apply the credits to your record

grants.description: Share information about the person you care for
grants.purpose: To verify your caring responsibilities and the care recipient's eligibility for qualifying benefits

grants.description: Verify the care recipient's disability benefits with DWP
grants.purpose: To confirm the person you care for receives a qualifying disability benefit at the required rate

grants.description: Share Care Certificate signed by health or social care professional (if applicable)
grants.purpose: Alternative evidence of caring responsibilities if care recipient does not receive a qualifying benefit

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Carer's Allowance Unit or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before decision. Existing credits on your NI record will not be removed.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot obtain Care Certificate signatures from health or social care professionals. Agent cannot submit application without your explicit confirmation of caring details and care recipient information. Agent cannot change your National Insurance record directly.
